svg.title: Prescription Pad Ordering
svg.desc: Customer journey and order handoff · retrospective wireframes. Full retrospective wireframe process with 8 editable screen frames, flow, annotations, and acceptance criteria.
svg.text: Customer journey and order handoff · retrospective wireframes
RETROSPECTIVE PRODUCT DESIGN PROCESS · STRUCTURE → TASK FLOW → STATES → HANDOFF
Each frame shows one meaningful customer state. Arrows and labels describe transitions between frames.
